# Pascal Sander

> Swiss male model and actor based in Zürich, Switzerland. Featured in Harper's Bazaar Serbia and L'Officiel Monaco.
> Personal site with long-form, first-person writing about modeling, acting, health
> and entrepreneurship. English language. Owner-written, non-commercial in tone.

## Who
Pascal Sander, model and actor (mother agency Fotogen, Zurich; also New Generation, Amsterdam
and Models Milano, Milan), and Head of Growth at Growis (https://growis.ch).
Studies at the University of St. Gallen (HSG). Based in Zürich, Switzerland.

## Pages
- [Home](https://pascalsander.ch/): overview of the three areas, client list, booking and collaboration form.
- [Modeling](https://pascalsander.ch/modeling.html): ten-chapter first-person account of a
  modeling career, campaigns (Coop, Galaxus, bfu, Botty, Nikon, Scoop), motion reel, FAQ.
- [Health](https://pascalsander.ch/health.html): sports, nutrition, micronutrients, FAQ.
- [Entrepreneurship](https://pascalsander.ch/entrepreneurship.html): entrepreneurship,
  personal branding and the Growis project.
- [Impressum](https://pascalsander.ch/impressum.html)
- [Datenschutz](https://pascalsander.ch/datenschutz.html)
